Breaking: Local Researchers Discover New Catalyst

A team of chemists at the Bryden Institute have demonstrated a new copper-iron alloy catalyst...
capture.bodyText: Breaking: Local Researchers Discover New Catalyst. A team of chemists at the Bryden Institute have demonstrated a new copper-iron alloy catalyst that converts carbon dioxide into ethanol with 81 percent efficiency.
